_readme: Ground truth for real D-Mart-class labels captured on the TC22.
Transcribed by reading each photograph. Conventions:
value   - the field is printed on the pack and reads exactly this,
already in the normalized form the server should produce
(YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD for dates, plain decimal for money).
null    - the field is genuinely ABSENT from the pack. Extracting
anything here is a false accept, the worst failure class
omitted - not legible enough in the photograph to assert a truth.
